frequency_question: How often do states with high intent and capability successfully establish domestic production of advanced guided weapons during wartime within two years?
membership_rule: Includes sovereign states initiating domestic production lines for foreign-designed guided missiles or complex defense systems during active conflict; excludes peacetime acquisitions or simple non-guided munitions.

cases.name: United Kingdom domestic production of US Oerlikon guns (WWII)
Soviet Union relocation and establishment of tank/aircraft manufacturing behind Urals
Israel domestic production of Gabriel anti-ship missiles post-embargo
Iran domestic reverse-engineering and production of TOW/Hawk missiles post-revolution
Ukraine domestic production ramp-up of Stugna-P anti-tank systems

coverage_note: 5 named cases representing major wartime advanced weapons localization efforts
known_gaps: Modern cruise missile manufacturing transfer involves proprietary software and specialized metallurgy that limits direct historical matches.
skeleton: 5 historical mobilization cycles for advanced weapons localization in crisis
multiplier: 4 hits out of 5 comparable historical precedents
validity_reason: Defense industrial base structures and crisis mobilization patterns change slowly over decades.
